# Third party files the deck loads

Kept here as plain files so the deck needs no build step and no internet.

| What | Version | Licence | From |
|---|---|---|---|
| xterm.js (`xterm/xterm.mjs`, `xterm/xterm.css`) | 6.0.0 | MIT, see `xterm/LICENSE` | npm `@xterm/xterm` |
| xterm fit addon (`xterm/addon-fit.mjs`) | 0.11.0 | MIT | npm `@xterm/addon-fit` |
| JetBrains Mono (`fonts/jetbrains-mono-*.woff2`) | latin subset | OFL 1.1, see `fonts/LICENSE-jetbrains-mono.txt` | npm `@fontsource/jetbrains-mono` |
| Chakra Petch (`fonts/chakra-petch-*.woff2`) | latin subset | OFL 1.1, see `fonts/LICENSE-chakra-petch.txt` | npm `@fontsource/chakra-petch` |

To update one, install the npm package somewhere and copy the same files over these.
